HIGH SCHOOL BOYS LEARNING TO MANIPULATE A COAST DEPT ST GUN.
Group of high school boys, ardent preparedness advocates, stanjüing beside one of the mortars in the 13th Coast Defense Com. nd. Brooklyn, N.Y.

These are students of the Boy's High School of Brooklyn and are part of the military organization of that school. They are uniformed in regulation khaki, puttees, hat, etc., and drill with rifles, going through manoeuvres and tactics. Once a week they drill at the Armory under the instruction of National Guard officers.

The afternoon at the Armory is looked forward to with great joy by the boys. The moment they enter the Armory they make for the guns and mortars mounted on the floor, and take their stations about the huge rifles. They take their duties seriously and pay strict attention to the instructions of the officers who explain the various working parts of these weapons, and who drill them in military tactics.
